visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a denim jacket enters a room illuminated with a strong blue light. On the white wall, a cardboard sign with blue tape reads '壓力時光屋'. He looks around with a confused and curious expression, his hands resting by his sides. (2) The camera zooms in on a digital control panel mounted on the wall. The screen displays a list of options: EXPECTATION, EXCLUSION, TIME PRESSURE, RESPONSIBILITY, and APPROVAL SEEKING. The man's finger presses the power button, which glows green. (3) The man selects 'EXPECTATION'. A blue 3D hologram of an older man with glasses holding a newspaper appears. The man in the denim jacket looks startled, recoiling slightly with a tense facial expression while the hologram remains static yet illuminated by flickering light. (4) The man selects 'EXCLUSION'. A new hologram of a younger man wearing a beanie and a button-down shirt appears. The protagonist looks to his side, his mouth slightly open in disbelief. (5) The man selects 'TIME PRESSURE'. A hologram of a man in a formal suit and tie appears, pointing a finger as if giving a stern command. The protagonist looks increasingly stressed, his brow furrowed. (6) The man selects 'RESPONSIBILITY'. A hologram of a digital presentation slide titled '2025 第四季行銷專案提案' is projected. The man stares at the text, his hands gripping his head in frustration. (7) The man selects 'APPROVAL SEEKING'. A social media post from 'Threads' appears as an overlay. The man is now lying face-down on the floor, his eyes wide and teeth gritted in a display of extreme mental fatigue. (8) The man takes a piece of blue gum from an 'Extra' brand bag and chews it. Suddenly, white star and circle graphics appear around him. He stands up, his posture straight and his expression transformed into one of calm confidence. (9) The scene shifts to an outdoor park. The man is seen sitting on a brown leather sofa placed on the grass, then walking energetically down a paved path. He passes another man with glasses who is holding the same gum. (10) Four bags of Extra sugar-free gum are arranged on a white surface. Text overlays provide promotional details about a 7-Eleven offer.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Initially a sterile, blue-lit studio room representing the 'Pressure Time Chamber' with white walls and a digital panel. Later, a sunlit outdoor public park with green trees and a paved walkway.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A fast-paced, upbeat electronic pop BGM begins, featuring a strong rhythmic pulse. A professional male narrator explains the concept of the 'Pressure Time Chamber' with clear, energetic articulation and high vocal arousal. (2) A sharp, metallic 'click' SFX triggers as the control panel is activated. The narrator's pitch remains high and engaging as he lists the pressure options. (3) A digital 'beep' SFX marks the selection of a new mode. A second male voice, deeper and more authoritative, represents the father hologram, delivering a line with a mix of warmth and implicit expectation. (4) A rapid 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs. A more casual, slightly higher-pitched male voice speaks, representing a friend, with a teasing and high-arousal tone about social gatherings. (5) Another button-press SFX. An authoritative, sharp-toned male voice representing the boss delivers a deadline command with strong dominance and falling intonation. (6) A short, dissonant digital chime SFX triggers. The protagonist's voice exhibits clear vocal tension and breathiness, conveying anxiety about project details and lack of progress. (7) A percussive 'thud' SFX as the character hits the floor. The BGM swells in volume. A distinct, crisp 'crunch' SFX is heard as the gum is bitten into, followed by a shimmering, high-frequency 'sparkle' SFX. (8) The BGM transitions to a more triumphant and bright major-key theme. The protagonist lets out a confident, loud shout with high valence. Ambient outdoor noise like distant wind is subtly present. (9) A series of plastic rustling SFXs occur as the gum bags are shown. The narrator returns with a very high speech rate to deliver the promotional terms and conditions.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Stress Simulation -> Solution -> Benefit -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Extra sugar-free gum by positioning it as a tool to relieve common 'micro-stressors' in modern life, such as parental expectations, social pressure, and work deadlines.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The brand logo 'Extra' is prominently displayed, and the protagonist's problem is solved specifically by consuming the product.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a sci-fi 'Pressure Time Chamber' metaphor to dramatize relatable daily stresses, effectively transitioning to a brighter aesthetic once the product is consumed.
